* [005 — SSR readiness by package — core/store DOM-free, css platform-return BUILT, resource already server-safe, dom importable-but-inert, html``/babel AST is the DOM-free seam](entries/005.md) — Verified 2026-07-10, re-verified 2026-07-11. core + store have zero DOM refs. css has platform-dependent return (BUILT): css()/cssVars() return text on server with zero state mutation, name/proxy on client (css.ts:37, cssVars.ts:27-41). resource IS server-import-safe (hasDocument at internal/lifecycle.ts:34, hasNavigator/hasWindow at cache.ts:22-24) — an earlier grep-based 'unguarded' claim was wrong, corrected by reading guard context. dom imports cleanly (no module-scope DOM access) but mountNode is hardwired to document.createElement (internal/render.ts:88) — yet component() (the dom symbol babel auto-imports into user code) IS server-EXECUTABLE, not just importable: packages/dom/lib/component.ts calls core's scope() (packages/core/lib/scope.ts:22) + the fn, dispatchError only on throw, zero mountNode/document/window refs. So a meta-framework SSR renderer can execute Component(props) and its nested component() calls server-side with no DOM; mountNode (the one hardwired to document.createElement) is never reached by the component() path. html`` parser + babel plugin produce HellaNode ASTs with zero DOM refs — the DOM-free seam the BUILT @hellajs/ssr stringifier walks (see 013). · `triggers: ssr-readiness, ssr, hydration, ssr-audit` · `tags: arch, ssr, core, css, dom, resource` · `type: decision`
* [006 — SSR-css track: platform-dependent return — BUILT (css()/cssVars() return text on server, name/proxy on client)](entries/006.md) — BUILT and verified 2026-07-10. css() returns CSS text on server (css.ts:37 — if (!hasDocument()) return cssText), returns name on client. cssVars() returns vars text on server (cssVars.ts:27-41), proxy on client. Server path is stateless: css() early-returns before injectedMap; cssVars() before any state/effects. The former 4 css-side maps collapsed to 1 (injectedMap in cssStore.ts). The <style> babel transform is deleted. Six alternatives were rejected; platform-dependent return preserves cssVars client reactivity. Tested in tests/ssr.test.ts (13 tests). · `triggers: css-return-type, platform-return, style-transform, css-server, ssr-css` · `tags: arch, css, ssr, babel, breaking-change` · `type: decision`
* [007 — HellaJS declares its own global JSX namespace in the dom barrel (packages/dom/lib/index.ts) — Element = HellaNode & RenderFn, not React](entries/007.md) — Verified 2026-07-28. Despite tsconfig `jsx: react-jsx` (a red herring that points at React), @hellajs/dom declares the global JSX namespace itself in its barrel — packages/dom/lib/index.ts:23-32, inside `declare global`: `Element = HellaNode & RenderFn` (render-fns ARE HellaNodes type-wise, via intersection), `IntrinsicElements extends HTMLAttributeMap`, `ElementAttributesProperty.props`, `ElementChildrenAttribute.children`. No other package redeclares it; importing @hellajs/dom is what activates the global for consuming code. So JSX.Element = HellaNode & RenderFn, assignable to ComponentReturn (HellaNode | (() => HellaNode)) — load-bearing for component() typing and any render-fn type reasoning. Locate via `rg 'namespace JSX' packages/dom/lib/index.ts`. · `triggers: jsx-namespace, jsx-element-type, component-typing, render-fn-type` · `tags: arch, types, dom, jsx, contract` · `type: decision`

There is no documented stance against <script> in shipped HTML, so React-style inline swap snippets in streamed output violate nothing. · `triggers: ssr-zero-runtime, inline-script, streaming-html, suspense-swap, zero-runtime-scope` · `tags: arch, ssr, streaming, hydration, contract` · `type: decision`
* [015 — Streaming SSR model β (stream-for-paint, hydrate-once) chosen over α (selective/streaming hydration) — HellaJS's cheap surgical hydrate deflates α's rationale](entries/015.md) — Verified 2026-07-12. β: ssrStream flushes shell + <Suspense> fallbacks and stages resolved children in <template>s; hydrate runs ONCE and its `case "suspense":` (swapSuspenseStage) swaps each staged template in (no inline script — chosen over the inline-script design for full testability, since HappyDOM does not execute innerHTML-inserted scripts) before adopting. α (React-style per-segment selective hydration) was rejected: its rationale is expensive hydration (React re-reconciles per segment), but HellaJS hydrate is a one-shot marker-reader with no reconcile, so deferred single-hydrate is cheap and α's hydrate-rework complexity is unjustified. α stays a future option layered at the swap points. · `triggers: streaming-ssr, suspense, selective-hydration, hydrate-model, alpha-beta-streaming` · `tags: arch, ssr, streaming, hydration, dom, suspense` · `type: decision`
* [016 — bun:test's expect(promise).rejects.toThrow() must be awaited — an unawaited matcher silently false-passes and leaves the rejection path uncovered](entries/016.md) — Verified 2026-07-12. In bun:test, expect(asyncThatRejects()).rejects.toThrow('msg') returns a Promise; without `await`, the test function returns before the assertion settles — the test passes whether or not the rejection actually fires, AND the rejection code path stays uncovered (coverage drops). Always write `await expect(...).rejects.toThrow(...)` (and `await` any `.resolves` matcher). · `triggers: rejects-matcher, unresolved-promise-assertion, bun-test-async, coverage-drop-rejection, false-pass` · `tags: testing, bun-test, async, coverage` · `type: decision`
* [018 — Router SSR is library territory — router({ url }) + synchronous init make the router server-runnable; no new primitive, no per-request rewrite for the sync path](entries/018.md) — Verified 2026-07-14. Router SSR is a library feature, NOT meta-framework territory (supersedes 017). RouterConfig.url resolves the initial route against a supplied URL instead of window.location, and router() init is now synchronous (direct updateRoute(), not queueMicrotask) — so router({ routes, url: pathname+search }); ssr(App()) runs on the server with no window, and the client omits url (reads window.location) then hydrate(App()). The view-signal handler pattern () => currentView(X) is the isomorphic style. Composes with existing ssr/ssrAsync/ssrStream + hydrate; no new primitive, no per-request rewrite for the sync path. · `triggers: router-ssr, isomorphic-routing, router-url-option, synchronous-init` · `tags: arch, ssr, router, isomorphic` · `type: decision`
* [019 — HappyDOM window.location.pathname is 'blank' (about:blank) and history.replaceState({}, '', '/') does NOT change it — router() init resolves 'blank', firing notFound for unmatched routes](entries/019.md) — Verified 2026-07-14. In the test env (utils/happydom.js GlobalRegistrator), window.location.pathname is the literal string 'blank' (about:blank), NOT '/'. setupRouterEnv's window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/') is a no-op for pathname. So router() — now with synchronous init — resolves the initial path 'blank', matches no route, and fires notFound during router(). Tests asserting handler/notFound call-counts immediately after router() must isolate the init firing (mockClear() after router()) or assert state (route().path/handler), since init is no longer deferred past the assertion. A test-env quirk, not production behavior. · `triggers: happydom-location, router-test-init, blank-pathname, notfound-call-count` · `tags: testing, router, happydom, env` · `type: decision`
* [020 — consumeRegion captured `next` AFTER removeChild → null (fixed: capture before removal)](entries/020.md) — Verified+fixed 2026-07-17. `consumeRegion` (`packages/dom/lib/internal/hydrate.ts`) returned `next: close.nextSibling` AFTER `parent.removeChild(close)` — a detached node's `nextSibling` is `null` per spec, and HappyDOM is spec-compliant (verified empirically: `b.nextSibling` → null after `removeChild(b)`). So every region-adoption caller (reactive child, fragment, isDynamic ForEach/Transition/Portal/Lazy/Suspense, raw) got `next=null` when a region was followed by a sibling, causing the sibling to hydrate-mismatch → fresh-mount-append → a DUPLICATE node + lost binding. Latent because no prior test paired a region with a following element sibling. Fix: capture `const next = close.nextSibling` before the `removeChild` calls. Full hydrate-adoption suite re-verified green after. · `triggers: consumeRegion, hydrate-region-adoption, nextSibling-after-remove, region-sibling-misalign` · `tags: arch, dom, hydration` · `type: correction`
* [021 — ssrStream's start() drives the async generator one microtask hop per yield — cancel/staged-swap tests must drain to the <!--hs sentinel AND await delay(0) before acting](entries/021.md) — ssrStream's ReadableStream start() consumes the shared async generator via `for await` (one microtask hop per yield); a test that cancels or asserts on staged state right after reading the fallback chunk acts BEFORE pending.push runs — drain until the `<!--hsN-->` sentinel flushes, then `await delay(0)` so start() resumes past the push, else the cancel/swap-return loop stays uncovered. · `triggers: ssrstream-cancel-test, suspense-staged-swap, microtask-yield-timing, streaming-test-tick, coverage-uncovered-cancel` · `tags: testing, ssr, streaming, bun-test, coverage` · `type: decision`

* [023 — HellaJS monorepo convention — all cross-package HellaJS deps are peerDependencies with carets; devDependencies are null everywhere; css is the sole package with a runtime dep (csstype — see Evidence)](entries/023.md) — Every packages/* package.json declares cross-pkg HellaJS deps ONLY as peerDependencies with caret ranges (ssr->dom ^1.4.2; dom/router/css/store/resource->core ^1.0.6); devDependencies are null across the board; css is the sole package with a runtime dep — csstype (^3.1.3), legitimate because CSS.Properties flows into the public CSSObject type shipped in dist/types.d.ts (consumers need it resolvable to type-check css({...}); import type is erased at runtime, not from the .d.ts). So 'mirror the sibling convention' for a NEW cross-pkg dep = add a peerDependency with a caret, NOT a devDependency or workspace. Caveat — a test-only cross-pkg dep (e.g. dom->ssr) is semantically a devDep and has no clean home under this convention (see 022). · `triggers: add-dependency, cross-package-dep, devdependency, peerdependency, package-json-convention` · `tags: arch, packaging, workspaces, config` · `type: decision`
* [024 — HellaNode marker properties are bare words (raw/static/componentScope/placeholder/dynamicComponent); __SLOT_N__ and __fragment__ parser tokens are KEPT __ on purpose — do not 'fix' them](entries/024.md) — Per guides/code.md (Naming->Variables, added 2026-07-17), internal marker PROPERTIES on HellaNode/HtmlPlaceholder/HtmlDynamicComponent dropped the __ prefix — __raw->raw, __static->static, __scope->componentScope, __placeholder->placeholder, __dynamicComponent->dynamicComponent (dom+ssr atomic, ssr reads `raw`). __SLOT_N__ and __fragment__ are STRING TOKENS injected into the HTML being parsed, not object properties — their __ is justified collision-resistance against arbitrary user text, so they are INTENTIONALLY KEPT. __scope->componentScope (not bare scope) because <th scope> is a real HTML attribute; componentScope mirrors ElementState.componentScope. · `triggers: underscore-marker, hella-node-fields, slot-token, fragment-token, componentscope, marker-rename` · `tags: arch, dom, ssr, naming, contract` · `type: decision`
* [025 — Pin typescript to ~6.0.x (tilde, not caret); cap below 6.1.0 — never bump to TS 7 until typescript-eslint ships TS 7 support](entries/025.md) — typescript is pinned ~6.0.3 across root+plugins+examples because typescript-eslint (latest 8.65.0 and canary 8.65.1-alpha.8) peer-caps at <6.1.0 and TS 7 (native Go port, npm dist-tag latest) moved its stable JS API to ./unstable/*, which breaks this repo's type-aware ESLint (eslint.config.mjs parserOptions.projectService); tilde not caret so a future bun install cannot drift into 6.1.x and silently break bun lint. · `triggers: typescript-version, dep-bump, typescript-eslint, lint-gate` · `tags: toolchain, deps, lint` · `type: decision`
* [026 — examples/ resolve @hellajs/* via ROOT node_modules walk-up (no declared deps); verify by RUNNING, never `bun add` into an example](entries/026.md) — Corrected 2026-07-28. Every examples/* package.json (blog/counter/todo/theme-switcher/ssr-islands/ssr-routing/ssr-streaming; bench too) declares NO @hellajs/* deps — `dependencies` holds only build tooling where present (bench: rollup), never an @hellajs/* entry — yet examples STILL RESOLVE @hellajs/* at runtime via ROOT node_modules/@hellajs/* symlinks (-> packages/*, current source) created by the root `bun install`, through Node walk-up resolution (the example's own node_modules has no @hellajs -> walks up to root). So `bun src/server.js` runs an example with ZERO local install. The committed folder is reference source; an external reader (no repo root) runs the tutorial's `npm install @hellajs/...`. Do NOT `bun add @hellajs/*` into an example to verify it: that installs STALE npm versions that shadow the root symlinks (dom@1.4.2 lacks $ref, css@1.1.1 lacks the server-safe css() return -> false 'feature not published' failures) AND mutates package.json with file: deps that must be reverted (restore package.json too, not just node_modules/bun.lock). Verify by just RUNNING the example; assert the tutorial's install line matches the code's imports. · `triggers: examples-deps, example-runnability, add-example, example-package-json, standalone-example, examples-convention, bun-add-shadow` · `tags: arch, examples, packaging, workspaces, config` · `type: decision`
* [027 — router({ url }) re-resolves on every call — the `!route().handler` init guard was skipping the path update for 2nd+ SSR requests (fixed)](entries/027.md) — Verified 2026-07-28 (fixed same day). router() init set the route path only when route().handler was unset (a client re-init protection), so a 2nd+ router({ url }) in one process kept the FIRST request's route — multi-request SSR rendered stale views. Fix: router.ts bypasses the guard when config.url is supplied (SSR explicit-url mode always re-resolves); client re-init (no url) is unchanged. Without it, per-request SSR (Bun.serve or a Vite SSR middleware calling router({ url }) per request) is broken after the first request. · `triggers: router-ssr, router-url-option, per-request-ssr, router-init-guard` · `tags: arch, ssr, router, isomorphic` · `type: correction`
* [028 — JSX component children arrive as an array (`children: [child]`); html\`\` as a single child — ssr's walkChild/walkChildGen must iterate arrays, not just single children (fixed)](entries/028.md) — Verified 2026-07-28 (fixed same day). babel-plugin-hellajs compiles <Comp>{child}</Comp> to component(Comp, { children: [child] }) — an ARRAY; html\`\` compiles <${Comp}>${child}</${Comp}> to props.children = child (single). The ssr walkers classified only single children and DROPPED arrays (fell through to 'nothing'), so JSX <Suspense>{...}</Suspense> streamed an EMPTY staged <template>. Fix: walkChild (sync, lib/ssr.ts) and walkChildGen (async, lib/internal/walk.ts) now branch on Array.isArray → delegate to walkChildren/walkChildrenGen; html\`\` single-child output is byte-identical (parity preserved). · `triggers: ssr-component-children, jsx-array-children, suspense-streaming, ssr-walker, html-vs-jsx` · `tags: arch, ssr, dom, jsx, babel, contract` · `type: correction`
* [029 — Vite SSR runs vite-plugin-hellajs on the server entry — ssrLoadModule('/src/server.tsx') transforms server-side JSX to HellaNode; a configureServer middleware streams the SSR HTML](entries/029.md) — Verified 2026-07-28. The vite-plugin-hellajs transform (enforce: 'pre', transforms .tsx/.ts/.jsx/.js, skips node_modules) runs in BOTH Vite's client pipeline AND its SSR pipeline, so server.ssrLoadModule('/src/server.tsx') yields a module whose JSX is already HellaNode (not React createElement). Runnable pattern: vite.config.js adds a plugin with configureServer(server) that, for each app route, ssrLoadModules the server entry (which exports render(url): ReadableStream<string>), writes chunks to the Node res, and hands module/asset URLs (/src/*, /@*, /node_modules/*, file extensions) to Vite via next(). This avoids Bun's built-in JSX (React runtime) silently taking over server JSX (wrong output, no error). · `triggers: vite-ssr, jsx-server-entry, ssrloadmodule, vite-plugin-server, configure-server-ssr` · `tags: arch, ssr, dom, jsx, vite, plugin` · `type: decision`
